title: Timestamp one billion seconds later
summary: An anniversary calculator adds exactly one billion seconds to a supplied ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Return the resulting timestamp in the required format. Add one billion seconds to an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.
requirements: Return an ISO UTC timestamp with milliseconds.
Treat one gigasecond as exactly 1,000,000,000 seconds.
Throw an Error containing Invalid date for invalid input.
hints: Add one billion times one thousand, then format using toISOString.
